## Description

Describe the change and the contract it affects.

## Verification

List the tests, static checks, benchmarks, or other evidence actually run.

## Checklist

- [ ] Change is scoped to the intended behavior.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated when behavior changed.
- [ ] Documentation reflects implemented behavior.
- [ ] No obsolete API or compatibility path was introduced unintentionally.
- [ ] Unverified assumptions or remaining risks are called out.
